description: Index IX_D (D) over F holds a time part, a repeated date and two Nulls. For each case [= 2020-01-15 ;; = 2020-02-20 13:30 ;; = 2020-02-20 ;; = Double 43845 ;; = Long 43845 ;; = "1/15/2020" ;; = "2020-01-15" ;; = Null ;; = 1899-12-30 ;; >= 2020-02-01 ;; > 2020-12-31 ;; < 2020-02-01 ;; <= 2020-01-15] (Date VARIANTs for the dates): fresh table-type recordset, Index IX_D, Seek, read NoMatch, BOF, EOF, ID and D; MoveNext and read; MovePrevious twice and read. Asks how date, serial-number and string keys are coerced, how a time part and a duplicate date take part, and where Null sorts. The fixture copy is opened read-only.
retentionNote: Designed r-cursor-1b probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
